Watch Chandragupta Maurya Episode - 88 now!
Synopsis :
Govishanka tries to engage Chandragupta in the fulfillment of his requirements. Durdhara tricks Govishanka and then locks Chandragupta in the palace of Hawa Mahal so that she can spend some time with him. Chandragupta escapes from the room. He decides to resolve the issue of Shipra after hearing Sthoolbhadra's revelation. Dhananand tricks his elders and diverts them to fight against the Pipliwan soldiers and keeps the other half army to implement his plan. Mura decides to lead the army of Pipliwan's soldiers in Chandragupta's absence.
